assumptions: Twenty-two logical coordinates serialize ten episodes and selected within-day ordering without estimating calendar or institutional duration.
Nine Agent/representation-gate parents and one aggregate Population retain all supported choice surfaces; no user or platform-content population is invented.
P_3 and P_5 aggregation do not imply one court, uniform state action, coordinated legislators, votes or a shared preference.
All baseline routes use one logical tick; delivered-message guards are explicit construction choices rather than recovered communication history.
Final negotiation values are qualified positions, not verified agreement, ownership transfer or implementation.
Outcome expectations are descriptive; evidence integrity and terminal transport, not endpoint matching, control release.

This is a declared-event-vocabulary-exposed baseline: all public field names and each actor's complete capability menu are visible from the first coordinate, including event-specific future terms. Generated result values and actual receipt remain distinct from that vocabulary. No historically prefix-clean information claim is made.

World feasibility is enforced by mechanism domains and state preconditions. Only explicit handler information_requirements are mandatory receipt admission. Other message guards, activation windows and priorities are selected Rule policy assumptions, not backend-neutral historical or institutional laws.
